located_observations.observation: Three clear left-aligned lines retain the first sentence, then break the second sentence after 나누며. The last line now contains the complete concluding phrase rather than one word.
Fee, deadline and invitation are visibly larger than repair-1, close in optical body height to the time/place. Invitation wraps to two lines. URL is a full-size final line.
The title is smaller relative to the fuller central explanation and practical information. Chair, flowing garment, two people and top tool exchange remain substantial framing elements.
Open Hangul counters, stable widths and phrase spaces; no letters touch the garment or chair. Painted textures remain separate from sharp flat type.

located_observations.location: right tear, left chair and top exchange
located_observations.observation: Visible white stitches follow the torn edge near the right fingers. Left hand continues to brace a back slat; screwdriver is exchanged across the table rather than shown tightening the chair.

copy.observations: All twelve entries visually present once. Paragraph and invitation soft wraps preserve word boundaries. No extra print, QR or logo seen.

assigned_style.observations: Continuous table with substantial opposing repair objects and working neighbors; coral, aubergine and light yellow-green painted scene. Figures remain modeled painterly forms rather than maximally reduced silhouettes.

substantive_non_glyph.observations: Shared screwdriver exchange, chair support, torn garment and visible repair stitches are meaningful non-glyph repair content that shapes the field.

information_relationship.observations: English/title/statement lead into contiguous description, then two adjacent usable event and participation groups. Shared table, arms, chair and inward fabric connect the image and reading plane.

hangul.observations: Precise flat upright sans, balanced consonant/vowel proportions and clear counters. Body has strong medium-to-bold weight and legible spacing at usage720.

function_contact.observations: Four arms/hands have readable ownership; tool and torn garment contacts are clear. Chair is physically supported and screws are visible, but tightening action remains indirect.

material_edges.observations: Consistent matte painted flesh, wood, table and fabric. No observed halo, broken copy edge or object/text occlusion.

basic_exclusion.observations: Large human exchange, substantial foreground chair and draped torn garment organize the full field. Text occupies the shared table opening instead of a separate sidebar or empty room; central grouped type remains conventional but connected to scene.

ratio.observations: 1672 × 941 native; allowed +0.5 pixel height rounding. No resizing.

residuals: Chair tightening is represented indirectly through bracing and exchanged screwdriver, rather than a driver visibly seated in the joint.
Painting uses strongly modeled figures and fabric within gouache-like brushwork; less silhouette reduction than the direction's most simplified interpretation.

Native original-detail displays were tiny patches. Full original was eventually displayed at native dimensions using high detail; this required an additional display-recovery call after the QA views. Strict full-view order was therefore interrupted.

first_tool_calls: original.png detail high / image detail high (full native view)

display_recovery.reason: Recovery of tool display failure, not a second glyph-ambiguity read.

viewing_note.observations: No text ambiguity drove repeated querying. Failed image displays were retained as a procedural limitation; source bytes were never edited.
